purpose.zh: 练大腿内侧，提升髋部控制
purpose.en: Build the inner thigh and improve hip control.

text.zh: 腿伸直，从外侧拉回并越过中线
text.en: Keep the leg straight and pull it in across your midline

text.zh: 侧对器械，靠近器械的腿扣绳索
text.en: Stand side-on to the machine with the cuff on the near leg.

text.zh: 骨盆保持水平，慢慢放回
text.en: Keep your pelvis level and return slowly.

commonErrors.en: Leaning the upper body to move the leg.

cautions.zh: 出现疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: If you feel pain, reduce the range, and stop if it continues.
